content_sections.heading: About SI-MET
content_sections.text: The State Institute of Medical Education and Technology (SI-MET) is a Government of Kerala undertaking with its office at TC 94/2750, Pattoor, Vanchiyoor P.O, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala State – 695035. Its Chairperson is the Minister for Health, Government of Kerala, and its Vice Chairman is the Secretary, Health & Family Welfare. The posts in this notification are faculty positions in SI-MET Nursing Colleges at Dharmadam, Thaliparamba and Udma.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: SI-MET has notified 19 vacancies in two posts. The notice does not give a college-wise or category-wise break-up. The posts are in SI-MET Nursing College Dharmadam and Thaliparamba (Kannur District) and Udma (Kasargod District). Candidates residing in Kannur and Kasargod districts will be given preference.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The application form asks for details of the BSc Nursing / Post Basic BSc Nursing and MSc Nursing degrees, the MSc Nursing speciality, the Kerala Nursing Council registration number with its validity, and experience after BSc Nursing and after MSc Nursing (clinical and teaching). Candidates must also furnish a valid KNMC Registration with the application. For the full eligibility of each post, see the official notification. The maximum age limit for candidates of both posts is up to 50 years. For retired hands, the limit is up to 59 years. The notice does not print a date as on which age is counted.

rows.experience: Total 3 years teaching experience after MSc Nursing in a collegiate program

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The notice marks both amounts as "likely to be enhanced". It names no other allowance, and it does not say how the pay of retired candidates is fixed. Nature of appointment: contract basis for one year, renewable based on satisfactory performance. Appointments made to the vacant posts under this notification are non-transferable to other colleges of SI-MET.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SI-MET Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The application is offline. The notice gives these steps: Download the application form from the website www.simet.in . There is a separate form for each post (Lecturer and Assistant Professor), with a space for a photograph. Pay the application fee through the SB collect link on the website, or download the challan form from the website and pay at any branch of SBI. Fill in the form, including the fee remittance details with the date of remittance and the amount. Attach the documents listed below. Address the application to The Director, SI-MET Pattoor, Vanchiyoor P.O Thiruvananthapuram 695035. Make sure the application is received by 18 November 2026 before 5 pm. Applications received after the last date will be rejected. The fee is paid through the SB collect link on the website ( www.simet.in ) or by challan at any SBI branch. The notice does not say whether the fee is refundable.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form downloaded from www.simet.in Detailed biodata Proof of age Copy of BSc Nursing and MSc Nursing degree certificates Mark lists Experience certificates Valid KNMC Registration Caste/Community certificate and Non-creamy layer certificate, for those eligible for communal reservation

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The application form records the candidate's permanent and contact address with district and PIN code, landline and mobile numbers, email ID, age and date of birth, gender, and caste and community (General / SC / ST / OBC). The form asks whether the candidate is presently working, and if so, the name of the post and the address of the institution. Candidates must sign a declaration that all statements in the form are true, complete and correct. For more details, contact 0471-2302400 / 9446028080 or visit www.simet.in . The SI-MET office email is [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in SI-MET Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 19 vacancies: 8 for Assistant Professor and 11 for Lecturer in SI-MET Nursing Colleges at Dharmadam, Thaliparamba and Udma.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for SI-MET Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be received by 18 November 2026 before 5 pm. Applications received after the last date will be rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for SI-MET Assistant Professor and Lecturer posts?
faq.answer: Both posts require MSc Nursing. Assistant Professor candidates also need a total of 3 years teaching experience after MSc Nursing in a collegiate program.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for SI-MET Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is up to 50 years. For retired hands, it is up to 59 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for SI-MET Assistant Professor and Lecturer?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay per month is Rs.33,320/- for Assistant Professor and Rs. 32,450/- for Lecturer. The notice says the pay is likely to be enhanced.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for SI-MET Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs 250/- for General and Rs 100/- for SC/ST candidates, paid through the SB collect link on www.simet.in or by challan at any SBI branch.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for SI-MET Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Download the application form from www.simet.in, attach the required documents and address it to The Director, SI-MET Pattoor, Vanchiyoor P.O Thiruvananthapuram 695035, so that it reaches by 18 November 2026 before 5 pm.

faq.question: Q8. Are the SI-MET faculty posts permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is on contract for one year and is renewable based on satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q9. Can retired candidates apply for SI-MET Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice allows retired hands up to 59 years of age, against the general maximum of up to 50 years.

faq.question: Q10. Will I be transferred to another SI-MET college after appointment?
faq.answer: No. Appointments under this notification are non-transferable to other colleges of SI-MET. Candidates residing in Kannur and Kasargod districts will be given preference.
